Door 003: Stock Room 
-Solid Core Wood Door, Size: 3'-0"x6'-8"
-2" Wide Metal Frame

Existing Door 001:
-“DETEX” ECL-600, Exit Control Lock.
-Change-out locking mechanism with “Medeco” lock core.
-Door operation shall be exclusively through “Detex” unit.
-Door closer “Canaropa”, Series 50, #53, aluminum finish, mounted store side (if not existing).
-Kickplate, “Yves” Series 8400, 10" [254] H x full width of door, brushed aluminum, mounted 1" from door’s bottom, both sides.
-Threshold medium/heavy duty aluminum threshold, full width of door opening (if not existing).
-Tenant identification signage, as per landlord requirements (exterior side).
-Peep/door viewer – Rockwood Model 622 5/8"[16], 180° wide-angle door viewer (or equal; chrome finish).
-Door buzzer – “Edwards” #17886-B button, #590 series transformer #662 buzzer w/ louvered coverplate & transformer mounting plate.
-Door shall not be operable from exterior; door operation shall be exclusively through Detex unit at interior/store side of door.

Existing Door 002:
-1 part “Stanley” spring type hinge #2060R (steel) 4" [102] x 4" [102], satin chrome finish (US26D).
-1 pair “Stanley” hinge #741 (steel), 4" [102] x 4" [102], satin chrome finish (US26D).
-Privacy lockset, “Schlage” S-Series (S40-D), Saturn lever, satin chrome finish (US26D).
-(3) Door silencers, “Baldwin” #4036.
-Kickplate, “Yves” Series 8400, 10" [254] H x full width of door, brushed aluminum, mounted 1" from door’s bottom, both sides.
-Floor door stop, “Yves” #436, aluminum finish (use #438 if door has a threshold).

New Door 003:
-Automatic door closer No.525M by Canaropa or equivalent c/w door stopper at a 90° angle. Supplied and installed by G.C.
-4" x 16" stainless steel push plate by “Richelieu” or equivalent.
-12" C/C pull handle w/ flat face #9030C32D by C.B.H. (pull handle to be installed first to ensure bolts are concealed).
-12" stainless steel kick plate on sales floor side.
-White vinyl sign “Staff Only” or “Privet”.
-Flip down door holder.
